name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited
summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead-acid storage batteries for industrial and automotive applications in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Lead Acid Batteries and Allied Products; and New Energy Business. The company provides new energy business related products; installation, commissioning, and maintenance services; and industrial chargers, integrated power systems, electric charging solutions, and battery energy storage systems, as well as lithium-based home UPS systems and hybrid inverter platforms for residential and small commercial applications.
